    Top and socle positions of a brick string module #

    Equation (2.1) in combinatorial form: in the string diagram of a brick string module of positive length, a position without incoming edges and a position without outgoing edges lie over different vertices.

    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.finrank_stringModule {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : IsString D w) :
    Module.finrank k (stringModule D w hw) = w.len + 1
    source
    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.vtx_ne_of_top_socle {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (hw : IsString D w) (hb : IsBrick B (stringModule D w hw)) (hn : 0 < w.len) (p q : Fin (w.len + 1)) (hp : ∀ (a : D.Q.A) (i : Fin (w.len + 1)), w.next a i ≠ some p) (hq : ∀ (a : D.Q.A), w.next a q = none) :
    w.vtx p ≠ w.vtx q
